propositions: Cloud's three whole-project readers (get_parent_map, get_comment_map, get_issuelinks_map) use an opaque cursor (nextPageToken + isLast) to paginate at 100 items/page, but had no test exercising more than one page; only single-page payloads with isLast: True were tested.

A regression net (test module with 27 passing + 1 xfailed) was added to verify all three readers recover 100% of seeded items across three pages and that cursor tokens advance and are echoed correctly in request bodies.

The net independently verifies both documented stop conditions (isLast flag and exhausted cursor token in both absent and null spellings) in isolation, ensuring neither condition alone is sufficient to mask a regression.

Mutation testing confirmed the net catches: unconditional break-after-first-page, the DC-style break-on-short-page bug (which no other oracle detects), and missing either stop condition (which causes infinite re-requests of the same cursor).

An AST guard was added to adapters/jira/*.py to prevent silent addition of a fourth unpaginated whole-project reader POSTing to /rest/api/3/search/jql without a nextPageToken loop, closing the same seam that existed on the DC side.

A real defect (rebar:cabc-7a98-d173-4d7c) was discovered: if a server repeats its cursor token without setting isLast, the readers spin forever in a byte-identical request/response cycle, swallowed by fail-open exception handling into a silently partial map; this is pinned by xfail(strict=True) pending a separate production fix.
